title: BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSources
description: Which sources contribute URLs the web_fetch tool may fetch. A key that is null was not set and allows every URL from that source.

user_input.description: Whether URLs in the text of user messages may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows them.

client_tool_results.description: Which custom tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows every custom tool's results.

server_tool_results.description: Which of the web_search and web_fetch tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows both.
